summary: Verified the sessionService refactor (split into services/session/tokens.ts + revocation.ts + slimmer sessionService.ts) is a pure refactor with no behavioural regression. Pre-commit file-size gate now passes (root cause of the missing GitHub commit). All backend regressions and the frontend smoke test pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: sessionService.ts=360, session/tokens.ts=102, session/revocation.ts=123 lines — all well under the 500-line gate.

Backend hot reload is disabled per note; backend was already restarted post-refactor. authMiddleware imports of isSessionRevoked/isKeptSession are satisfied via re-exports in sessionService.ts (verified indirectly by 100% pass of e2e_signout_others.sh which exercises those paths).
seed_data_creation: None. Only read/session operations on user 1 as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pre-commit gate: `node backend/scripts/check-file-size.mjs` -> exit 0, '[file-size] OK'. `sh scripts/preflight-tsc.sh` -> exit 0, 'All staged TS gates passed'. sessionService line counts: 360/102/123. e2e_signout_others.sh: before 200/200/200 -> revoke 3 -> after 200/401/401, sessions 200/401, mobile refresh 401, desktop refresh ok=yes, new desktop token 200, twice 200, relogin 200. Single-device revoke: A=200, B=401. KYC status approved for company_id in {none,1,165,179,71}; /api/public/merchant-verification?handle=devhub verified=true. rca of the issue: The GitHub commit didn't appear because the .husky/pre-commit hook runs backend/scripts/check-file-size.mjs which failed for backend/services/sessionService.ts (577 lines > 500 gate). Fix: split into session/tokens.ts (102) + session/revocation.ts (123) + slimmer sessionService.ts (360) that re-exports the public API used by authMiddleware and controllers. Gate now passes; behaviour unchanged (all regression suites green).
